newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of CPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of CPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed on Friday in featureless trade, dealers said.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. August consumer price index and retail sales data.
The consumer price index for August is forecast to show an increase of 0.2 percent compared with a 0.3 percent gain reported in July.
August retail sales are expected to show an increase of 0.7 percent against July's 0.1 percent gain.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. All eyes are on tonight's consumer price index and retail sales numbers. But most people have squared or are squaring their positions for the weekend, so I don't think there will be much impact," a local dealer said.

In day-to-day rates, weekend, Monday/Tuesday and week-fixed were unchanged from Thursday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively. Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at Thursday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2, six-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent. -- P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
